9.text: AMD crossed a $1 trillion market cap after a 25.4% rally since August 3, with Q2 data center revenue up 107% Y/Y and Q3 guidance near $13 billion. Analysts debate whether the roughly 80x forward P/E is justified, with ratings split between Buy, Hold, and trim.

10.text: Chip stocks fell on AI safety concerns and U.S.-Iran tensions, then rebounded to three-month highs as retail investors sold semiconductor ETFs at a record pace. Bank of America named Nvidia, Intel, Micron, Marvell and Lam Research top picks, with Micron's results the next demand read.

8.text: Marvell tripled in 2026, landed a Google deal, and trades at roughly 80–91 times earnings after 37% sales growth and raised guidance. Intel, Qualcomm, and Micron posts barely mention AMD, so they bear on it only as AI-chip peers.

7.text: AMD agreed to acquire World Labs, the AI research startup co-founded by Fei-Fei Li, in an $8.2 billion stock deal—its second-largest ever—to expand into physical AI, robotics, and simulation. Separately, HPE won its first AMD Helios order, a $1.2 billion rack-scale deal with Vultr using AMD GPUs, CPUs, networking, and ROCm software.

12.text: Nvidia raised its buyback to $235B through 2028, reported 90%+ revenue growth and $96B quarterly revenue, and trades at 28.6x trailing earnings, below its three-year average. Analysts call it undervalued; AMD is mentioned only as not a serious threat to Nvidia's GPU dominance.

11.text: AMD appeared only in a Sept. 30 market-preview watchlist, with no company-specific developments reported. The other articles cover broad market moves, Micron earnings, AI-risk news, and S&P 500 gappers.

13.text: AMD is compared with Applied Materials as an AI semiconductor investment, with Applied Materials cited as cheaper (P/E 23.4x) and improving. AMD also appears in coverage of AI chip demand and competition.

14.text: Cathie Wood’s ARK funds and Donald Trump both hold the same 32 stocks, while AI-themed ETFs and Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI draw investor attention. AMD is not mentioned in these articles.
